class.name: RemoteControlServer
class.brief_description: HTTP remote control server for the Blazium editor and optional game runtime.
class.description: Exposes a localhost JSON HTTP API on [code]/v1/*[/code] using the [HTTPServer] singleton so [code]blazium-cli remote[/code] (and other clients) can query status, list commands, execute registered commands, read paginated engine logs ([code]GET /v1/logs[/code]), inspect debugger/Autowork state via [code]/v1/exec[/code], and optionally evaluate expressions. [code]POST /v1/exec[/code] and [code]POST /v1/eval[/code] are held and completed on the main thread so scene/editor work does not block the HTTP poll thread. Built-in editor play commands include [code]play_main_scene[/code], [code]play_current_scene[/code], [code]play_custom_scene[/code], [code]pause_playing[/code], [code]resume_playing[/code], [code]stop_playing[/code], and [code]play_status[/code]. Snapshot commands [code]snapshot_editor[/code] and [code]snapshot_scene[/code] return PNG as [code]png_base64[/code] (optional [code]args.path[/code] also writes a file); use [code]blazium-cli remote snapshot editor|scene -o file.png[/code] to save locally. Enable with ProjectSettings [code]blazium/remote_control/server_enabled[/code] or command-line [code]--enable-remote-control[/code]. Port and auth: [code]--remote-control-port=<port>[/code] (default [code]6507[/code], or [code]blazium/remote_control/server_port[/code]) and [code]--remote-control-token=<token>[/code] (or [code]blazium/remote_control/token[/code]). Default bind is [code]127.0.0.1:6507[/code]. [code]POST /v1/eval[/code] accepts [code]{ "expression": "...", "language": "gdscript" | "luau" }[/code]. Luau requires the [code]luau_module[/code] and is sandboxed. Prefer [code]blazium-cli remote[/code] as the client surface.

method.name: eval_expression
method.description: Evaluates [param expression] as GDScript ([Expression]) or Luau ([param language] [code]gdscript[/code]/[code]gd[/code] or [code]luau[/code]/[code]lua[/code]) when [member allow_eval] is enabled.

method.name: get_status
method.description: Status payload (project path, pid, mode, port, [code]instance_id[/code], [code]luau_eval_available[/code], etc.).

method.name: is_started
method.description: Returns whether remote control routes are active.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts listening (if needed) and registers [code]/v1/*[/code] routes.

method.name: stop
method.description: Unregisters routes and stops the HTTP listener if this server started it.

members.member: Short id for this editor process, assigned after startup by [code]blazium-cli[/code] ([code]POST /v1/instance[/code]). Exposed on [code]/v1/health[/code] and [code]/v1/status[/code] as [code]instance_id[/code].
Optional bearer token. When set, clients must send [code]Authorization: Bearer <token>[/code] or [code]X-Remote-Control-Token[/code].
